dct_description_sm: The ice thickness of the Milne Ice Shelf, Glacier and floating ice tongue were taken to fill in gaps in the thickness map of the ice shelf (Mortimer et al, 2012 Journal of Geophysical Research: 117), to better understand the characteristics of the grounding line of the Milne Glacier and to map the thickness of the ice tongue.  Subsequently (2014 - 2017) we have been interested in mapping the shape of cracks and other surface depressions on the ice shelf as well as the Milne Glacier grounding line.
dct_title_s: Milne Ice Shelf and Milne Glacier ice thickness data, 2012-2017
